entry.title: Mice with human brain cells offer a tool to study disease. Ethicists ask: What's next?
entry.summary: Neuroscientists have made a major advance in modeling the human brain in mice, offering a new way to study conditions like cerebral palsy. Ethicists ask if it changes how these mice should be treated.

entry.title: Senators question Trump's picks for top health positions, including surgeon general
entry.summary: On Wednesday, the Senate committee on health held a confirmation hearing for three top health officials, including surgeon general. Dr. Nicole Saphier is President Trump's third attempt to nominate a surgeon general.

entry.title: New maps reveal massive gaps in access to affordable birth control across the U.S
entry.summary: Because of a data lag, the current reality of access may be even worse.

entry.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
entry.summary: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.

entry.title: Step, stand, stairs
entry.summary: When it comes to longevity, lots of research has shown how much you move matters. But a new study finds your pace may also be key -- even if you fall far short of daily step goals.

entry.title: NPR looked for ChatGPT's new crisis feature. It's hard to find
entry.summary: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

entry.title: Research finds short bursts of vigorous movement are also beneficial for longevity
entry.summary: When it comes to longevity, lots of research has shown how much you move matters. But a new study finds your pace may also be key -- even if you fall far short of daily step goals.

entry.title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
entry.summary: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

entry.title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health
entry.summary: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

entry.title: Black women are more likely to experience pregnancy trauma and have their pain ignored
entry.summary: Black mothers in the U.S. are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related causes than white women. Actress Tatyana Ali became an advocate after her own awful experience giving birth.
